items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: I don't know much about his band at all. We'll have to look up on Blessing.

ctx.x: He had a good orchestra too. I don't remember so much... Who was Blessing? Blessing. That was Blessing's band, wasn't it? Blessing. Blessing. He played trumpet. And I don't know much about his band at all. We were speaking about our section. No. We'll have to look up on Blessing. I don't think you'll find anyone in his band living yet, huh?
No. Because I don't know. He's...
